_comment: Payment model of the ops suite: mapping of the product contract (ops-framework/docs/ADDING_A_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_MODEL.md) to this landscape. Generated by tools/payment_model.py into src/paym (active sections) and config/payment_model/pending (sections waiting for a VERIFY item). Expressions are CDS fragments over the tables / views named in from and joins. Only confirmed or already-delivered fields are active (docs/USAA_Known_Tables.md); everything else is null with its VERIFY note, or a pending section.

notes: Base: ZI_CD_PayLifeRun - the newest non-proposal DPAYH row of every payment document, run date LAUFD in the
last 45 days (key range of the DPAYH primary index; Performance_Review.md section 11). Flow from TFK042Z-XEINZ of
the company code country, method class from posting area ZPMC (ZI_CD_PayMethodCls), source / outcome / finding
/ late from the payment worklist (ZI_CD_PayWorkState; a clean payment has none - source unknown bucket).
joins: left outer join t001               as Cc  on  Cc.bukrs        = Pay.CompanyCode
left outer join tfk042z            as Pm  on  Pm.land1        = Cc.land1
left outer join ZI_CD_PayMethodCls as McC on  McC.Flow        = 'C'
left outer join ZI_CD_PayMethodCls as McD on  McD.Flow        = 'D'
left outer join ZI_CD_PayWorkState as Ws  on  Ws.ClearingDoc  = Pay.PaymentDocument

Flow.expr: cast( case when Pm.xeinz = 'X' then 'C' when Pm.zlsch is null then ' ' else 'D' end as abap.char( 1 ) )

TransactionType.verify: V83: transaction of the request (field of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG confirmed by the user 2026-11-11, name VERIFY-SE11) - reached through the request (pending section); blank until then

RequestStatus.verify: V84: business request lifecycle status (PENDING / SCHEDULED / SRCPOSTED / source reject) - no confirmed table / field (control_seed.md section 2a P2)

MethodClass.expr: cast( case when Pm.xeinz = 'X' then McC.MethodClass else McD.MethodClass end as abap.char( 3 ) )

HouseBankAccount.verify: V87: DPAYH-HKTID (account ID, never the bank account number) not yet confirmed - blank until SE11

notes: Payment -> requests: open items cleared by the payment document (DFKKOP-AUGBL = payment document, confirmed
join) with their FIN number (DFKKOP-ZZ_FIN_TRANS_NUM, confirmed); one row per payment and FIN. Request ->
payments reads by ZZ_FIN_TRANS_NUM (index of pre-check 0.8); payment -> requests by AUGBL (index V88).

CompanyCode.verify: VERIFY-DDIC DFKKOP-BUKRS (standard name, as config/hck_seed.md section 4)

request.reason: V82: FIN-number, received date / time, company code, currency and amount fields of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG and the transaction field are VERIFY-SE11 (docs/USAA_Known_Tables.md); the SUCCESS-row rule is applied (never the highest COUNTER)
notes: The accepted attempt of a request = its row with ZZ_STATUS SUCCESS (confirmed rule: never the highest COUNTER,
a failed attempt can be written after the success).

RequestReference.expr: cast( Log.‹FIN number field› as abap.char( 40 ) )

FeederReference.expr: Log.‹feeder business reference field (claim / policy / invoice)›
FeederReference.verify: V89 VERIFY-SE11; masked by default (feeder row REF_VISIBLE blank)

request_attempt.reason: V82: FIN-number, company code and received time fields of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG are VERIFY-SE11

RequestReference.expr: cast( Log.‹FIN number field› as abap.char( 40 ) )

IsAccepted.expr: cast( case when Log.zz_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'X' else ' ' end as abap_boolean )

request_event.reason: V90: the hops need a consumer union view (request log received time, PRISM status API / FMON event of the request's file, payment run, ZCD_SPE_EXCP_LOG status sent back) - the link request -> file and every SPE field are VERIFY-SE11
request_event.from: ‹ZI_CD_PaymHops - union of the hops, built after SE11› as Hop
